shortDescription: Higher gasoline prices probably pushed overall US inflation higher in September even as underlying price pressures eased, according to Bloomberg.The report said the data support expectations that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates this month.

children: Higher gasoline prices probably pushed overall US inflation higher in September even as underlying price pressures eased, according to Bloomberg.
The report said the data support expectations that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates this month.

title: US CPI Seen Rising on Higher Gasoline Prices
